Sponsored Products

Product Overview

Sponsored Products is an advertising solution that helps your products appear in shopping results pages.

Key features include keyword targeting, product targeting, and automatic bidding strategies.

Core Features

  • Cost-per-click pricing: You only pay when customers click your ad
  • Keyword targeting: Target specific keywords related to your products
  • Product targeting: Target specific product categories or individual products
  • Automatic bidding: Let Amazon optimize your bids automatically
  • Daily budget control: Set your maximum daily spend

Account Limits

Maximum products per ad
Up to 100 products can be included in a single sponsored products ad
Maximum campaigns
Each account can create up to 50 sponsored products campaigns
Minimum daily budget
$1.00 minimum daily budget per campaign
Maximum daily budget
$10,000 maximum daily budget per campaign

Bidding Strategies

Choose from three bidding strategies:

  1. Dynamic bids - down only: Lower your bids in real-time when your ad may be less likely to convert
  2. Dynamic bids - up and down: Raise or lower your bids in real-time based on likelihood of conversion
  3. Fixed bids: Use your exact bid for all keyword or product targets

Eligibility Requirements

To use Sponsored Products, you must:

  • Have a professional seller account or vendor account
  • Sell products in the catalog (not just custom products)
  • Comply with Amazon's advertising policies
  • Have a buy box for the products you want to advertise

Performance Metrics

Track your advertising performance with these key metrics:

  • Impressions: Number of times your ad was shown
  • Clicks: Number of times customers clicked your ad
  • Click-through rate (CTR): Percentage of impressions that resulted in clicks
  • Cost-per-click (CPC): Average amount paid per click
  • Spend: Total amount spent on the campaign
  • Sales: Total attributed sales from the campaign
  • Return on ad spend (ROAS): Ratio of sales to spend
